description: This file contains PHP functions for handling JSON responses related to workflow components in vtiger CRM, including fetching module fields, functions, dependent modules, and owners list.

methods.name: vtJsonFields
methods.description: Fetches module fields using VTExpressionsManager and outputs as JSON.

methods.name: vtJsonFunctions
methods.description: Retrieves expression functions from VTExpressionsManager and outputs as JSON.

methods.name: vtJsonDependentModules
methods.description: Determines dependent modules based on database queries and module references, outputs as JSON.

methods.name: vtJsonOwnersList
methods.description: Gathers active users and groups, outputs as JSON list of owners.
